$comment: Open decisions from AET_FINAL_SPEC §13. Launch gate: no page ships while it still contains a fabricated fact.

decisions.question: Which logo is the production mark — original illustrative/script, or simplified lotus/A?
decisions.note: Recommendation in spec §10: simplified for digital, original for print/signage.

decisions.question: Publish a street address, or 'Pinole, CA — address on booking'?
decisions.note: The spec inferred a home business from the flyer and the #homebusinesses hashtag and recommended withholding. That inference was wrong. The address was briefly stripped from contact.html and js/data.js on 2026-08-26 and restored the same session.
decisions.resolution: Publish the street address. 1622 Michael Dr, Pinole, CA 94564 is the shop's address.

decisions.question: Confirm 19 years licensed / 16 years owner; supply licence number
decisions.note: Years corrected from 18 to 19/16 on 2026-08-26. Licence number still missing.

decisions.question: Confirm real opening hours — VLS board and Drive bundle conflict
Approve 3 testimonials with names, or pull from Google with permission
decisions.note: Two are now sourced from her own about page (Jamiah P., Benjamin J.). Cinthia Z. remains unverified board filler.

decisions.question: Prices for peels, lashes, LED, RF facial
decisions.note: LED ($50) and lashes ($60 intro) now sourced. Standalone peel and RF facial still unpriced.

decisions.question: Booking provider — Square, Calendly, Acuity, or Wix
decisions.note: Swap point is sendRequest() in js/booking.js.

decisions.question: Is æve a sub-line of AET or a separate brand?
decisions.note: Spec recommends a distinct token set; do not merge palettes.

decisions.question: Before/after images plus written client consent

infrastructure.question: Point ambersessentialtouch.com at Render
infrastructure.note: Domain registered 2026-08-06 via Google Workspace signup; partner registrar Squarespace. DNS is managed at Squarespace (credentials via Google Admin > Account > Domains > Manage Domains > View Details). Apex A records and the www CNAME still point at Squarespace 'Coming Soon'. Render CLI has no domain command — dashboard only.

infrastructure.question: Which domain is canonical — .com or .net?
infrastructure.note: AET_FINAL_SPEC §2 says .net, because Amber's flyer and IG both print it. The .com was bought later and the site's canonical tag currently points at the Render origin. A live Squarespace site also sits on .net.

infrastructure.question: Retire the Squarespace site on .net?
infrastructure.note: Audited 2026-08-05: 6 pages, real price menu, two real testimonials, empty store, no booking widget, no MX. Its menu is the source for data/services.json.

infrastructure.question: Authorise the Drive connector for the ambersessentialtouch.com Workspace account
infrastructure.note: Amber's Workspace Drive is unreachable from the jayjouna@gmail.com connector. Blocks any folder consolidation.
